disclosure_title: Experimental Comparison: Data Interpretation and Limitations
model_limitations: kernel-only start (inventory-matched start node); constant diffusion coefficient per layer evaluated at the test temperature from the first hour (heating ramps are not modelled); no radioactive decay and no fission-product generation in the solver yet; perfect interface contact; absorbing outer surface; one intact particle, no matrix; the model fraction is a fraction of the particle's own inventory
relative_deviation_rule: undefined for a measured value <= 0; no floor is applied because the register states no detection floor (decision 17)
